## The refusal census (J264, N-58), re-measured

Probe P1 ran in the mirror. It runs `runSequenceOutcomes` on every M0 constructive case at draws 1 and 2, in both
forms. Each non-commit outcome is classed against the case's own `expect`.

| run | sequences | batches | commit | refused | threw | refusals off their case's expectation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before (main's `constructive.ts`, exact) | 166 | 480 | 455 | 23 | 2 | 11 (9 + the 2 throws) |
| after, callback form | 166 | 492 | 467 | 25 | 0 | 9 |
| after, declared form (new) | 166 | 399 | 374 | 25 | 0 | 9 |

* **Totals.** The before row equals the builder's figures. The round adds 12 later batches, and all 12 commit.
* **The 25 non-commit outcomes.** They are the same 25 in both forms, and the same set as a reconstruction of the old
  reading (diffed by case and code).
* **The 16 matching their case.** `E_NOT_TWO_CROSSINGS`: the grazing-reflex cuts and the through-vertex cut.
  `E_BELOW_MIN_EDGE` / `E_DEGENERATE`: the one-item chains and the pinched face. All are UNLAWFUL / REFUSE, each
  case's stated code.
* **The 9 off their case's expectation.** All are inherited and ruled (note N-17):
  * `limit/degen-self-touching-chain`, E_INVARIANT ×2: C-0227 (11).
  * `expect/reject-min-angle`, `expect/repair-angle-rejected` (×2 each) and `limit/every-rung` #2, E_NOT_TWO_CROSSINGS,
    the graze: C-0227 (10).
  * `limit/one-item-chain-optional`'s probe, E_DEGENERATE ×2: the harness's own zero-length probe, UNLAWFUL / REFUSE.
* **Verdict.** No lawful-input refusal, before or after: 0 → 0. The census did not rise (CONFIRMED). M0-a-06's
  fixtures are unchanged, and their `expect`s are asserted by permute.test.ts.
